TUTORIAL_INTRODUCTION_MESSAGE:
In this task, you will participate in a small game.

You will be presented with offers that allow you to earn and accumulate points.
Each offer will indicate how many points you can earn.

You will need to decide whether you accept or decline each offer.

  • If you accept, you will need to complete the effort task to earn the points.
  • If you decline, you move on to the next offer without earning points.

At the end of the game, the accumulated points will be converted and added to your compensation (gift voucher).

We will guide you at each step and you will have the opportunity to practice.
Please follow the instructions at each step carefully.

TRIAL_BLOCKS_DIRECTIONS:
During this next phase of the experiment, you will have the choice to skip or accept a trial.

You may skip the trial with the Left Arrow on your keyboard
or
you may accept a trial with the Right Arrow on your keyboard.

If you accept the trial, you may have to complete a tapping task. The required target area will be shown in blue. If the top of the red bar reaches the target area during the trial, you will receive the reward shown.

Sometimes, when you accept a trial, you will not need to complete the task and you will immediately see "Trial Successful", in which case you will receive the reward for free, however, you will not know this before accepting.

ⓘ Before each block, you will have a set of practice trials to familiarize yourself with the task.
REWARD_PAGE_DIRECTIONS:
During this part of the experiment, you will also start earning your bonus, based on the number of points you collect.

For each trial offered, you will see what tapping effort you need to provide to succeed, based on the height of the target area. You will also see the reward (in points) you will receive if you complete the trial successfully.

Each point is worth approximately 0.01 EUR.

For each trial, the question is:

Is it worth putting in this much tapping effort for this reward? 🤔

If you accept, you may need to perform the tapping and if you succeed, you will receive the points, if you fail, you will not receive the points
If you decline, you will move on to the next trial and you will not receive any points.

Your final bonus (max. 6 EUR) is based on the percentage of the total points you collect.
